The assertion `even_bit_set_number(10) == 10` means "even bits" are 1-indexed positions 2, 4, 6, ..., which are 0-indexed bits 1, 3, 5, ... . Under the 0-indexed reading, 10 (`1010`) would become 15.

```python
def even_bit_set_number(n):
    # Build a mask with the 1-indexed even bits (0-indexed 1, 3, 5, ...)
    # set, up to the bit length of n, then OR it into n.
    mask = 0
    i = 1
    while i < n.bit_length():
        mask |= 1 << i
        i += 2
    return n | mask
```
